st: Detective Manolis tells Ben Urich that Daredevil is only a legend, then leads the police into the church where Bullseye falls.

files.notes: Credited 'Detective Nick Manolis' (Wikipedia cast); 'Nick' and 'detective' are said to him by Urich. The wiki calls him a captain, but the screen and the cast list say detective. Group NYPD: never said in the transcript, but he leads uniformed police at the church; the app already uses 'NYPD'. If the owner prefers, Independent. The church step (police storm in, a sniper shoots Bullseye's hands) rests on the transcript ('Freeze! Don't move! Detective, look!') and the Wikipedia plot; the wiki's claim that he orders his men to fire could not be confirmed line by line.

add.k: A corrupt FBI agent on Jimmy Woo's team
st: On Jimmy Woo's FBI team, Stoltz secretly feeds Sonny Burch, arrests Hank and Hope, and is killed by Ghost as he takes their lab.

files.notes: Credited name; transcript has his lines to Woo ('Sorry, sir. But I just got a lead.'), his reply to Burch's call ('Understood.') and the arrest ('Hank Pym. Hope Van Dyne. You're under arrest.'). FBI is said on screen.

st: At the Triskelion, Klein refuses Rumlow's order to launch the helicarriers, citing Captain's orders, and Sharon Carter covers him.
Aboard Fury's old helicarrier over Sokovia, Klein launches the lifeboats and reports them filling with people.

files.notes: DRAFT2's own example drops him (credits only), but FILMNAME.md (10 November ruling) lifts the name test for films, so he gets a file under his credited name. Group S.H.I.E.L.D. in both: Fury's helicarrier crew is called S.H.I.E.L.D. on screen ('This is what S.H.I.E.L.D. is supposed to be'), and the app's S.H.I.E.L.D. file covers the Sokovia helicarrier.

add.k: Natasha's trainer in the Red Room
st: In Natasha's vision of the Red Room, Madame B. drives the young Natasha through brutal training toward a graduation ceremony.

files.notes: No page_file; built from the transcript ('Again.' 'You'll break them.' 'Only the breakable ones.' 'We'll celebrate after the graduation ceremony.' 'The ceremony is necessary for you to take your place in the world.') and Wikipedia's cast note (Madame B., who mentored Black Widow). The Red Room is named by Natasha in the same film. Raft file as a Red Room trainer; her only appearance is in a vision of the past. cl Street is a judgment call.

add.k: A gunman working with Ulysses Klaue
st: Posing as a medic, Limbani helps Klaue rob a London museum and break out of CIA custody, then Killmonger shoots him at the airfield.

files.notes: Credited name (MCU wiki credits: David S. Lee as Limbani). Lines checked in the transcript: the museum medics are Klaue and Limbani, and the subtitles label them only MEDIC 1 and MEDIC 2 ('Let's give the lady some space, please' / 'Step back, please, gents'), so one of those lines is his but which one cannot be fixed by order; 'Let's get going, boss' at the airfield is his (the only one of Klaue's own crew there, just before Killmonger asks to go to Wakanda). Klaue's crew is never named on screen, so Independent.

st: Sope gives Killmonger the Heart-Shaped Herb, then, choked by him, obeys his order to burn the rest of the garden.
Sope leads T'Challa's funeral rites, then helps prepare Shuri's coronation, where M'Baku steps up to claim the throne.

files.notes: Credited 'Shaman' in Black Panther and 'Sope the Shaman' in Wakanda Forever; the batch name Sope is used throughout with no staging, per FILMNAME.md. BP lines confirmed in the transcript (SHAMAN: 'Allow the Heart-Shaped Herb...', 'My King, we cannot do that. It is our tradition'). Her funeral speech and coronation role in Wakanda Forever rest on the MCU wiki page; the funeral speech is likely in Xhosa and is not in the subtitles I have. Checked: the Black Panther credits give only 'Shaman', but the Wakanda Forever credits (MCU wiki credits page) give 'Sope the Shaman', so a film's credits do name her; kept.

k: The Mining Tribe's elder on Wakanda's council
A senior elder on Wakanda's council
st: On the council, the Mining Tribe elder Zawavari laughs at Killmonger's claim to the throne, then must bow to him as king.
Zawavari presses the elders to choose a ruler, then presents Shuri at her coronation, where M'Baku claims the challenge instead.

files.notes: Credited 'Mining Tribe Elder' in Black Panther and 'Zawavari' in Wakanda Forever; the batch name is used throughout with no staging, per FILMNAME.md. 'The Mining Tribe' is said on screen at T'Challa's coronation; Wikipedia says she has left that seat to be Elder Statesman in Wakanda Forever, so her group moves to Wakanda (the app's name for the nation). 'Elder Statesman' is not used in k since I could not confirm it is said. Her laugh at Killmonger and her Wakanda Forever lines ('Every day that passes without selecting the ruler is a day wasted', 'And now I present to you Princess Shuri, the Black Panther!') are attributed by the MCU wiki and match the transcript. Checked: Wakanda Forever credits (MCU wiki) list Connie Chiume as 'Zawavari', and Wikipedia's Wakanda Forever cast says she reprises her role as Zawavari; kept.

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: At the subway where Jose Quesada died, Detective Manolis tells Urich he is wasting his time and that there is no proof Daredevil even exists. He brushes Urich off again at Nikolas Natchios's murder scene.
stages.whoA: The reporter who keeps chasing Daredevil
stages.whoB: Detective Manolis, who calls Daredevil a legend

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Manolis works the scene after Bullseye murders Nikolas Natchios. Later he leads the police into the church where Bullseye is fighting Daredevil, and a police sniper shoots Bullseye through both hands.
stages.whoA: The killer the police take down at the church
stages.whoB: Manolis, the detective whose police storm the church

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Stoltz serves on Agent Woo's team, pushing Bill Foster too hard until Woo stops him. He brings Woo a lead on Hank and Hope, leads the raid that arrests them, and is found dead after the lab is stolen.
stages.whoA: His boss, who never learns he is crooked
stages.whoB: Stoltz, the agent who secretly works for Burch

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Burch pays Stoltz, his special friend at the FBI, for inside information. Burch gives him the location of Hank and Hope in exchange for the lab, and Stoltz agrees.
stages.whoA: The dealer who pays him to leak
stages.whoB: Stoltz, his paid mole in the FBI

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: As Stoltz loads Hank's shrunken lab into his car for Burch, Ghost phases her hand into his chest and kills him, then takes the lab.
stages.whoA: The phasing thief who kills him
stages.whoB: Stoltz, the agent she kills for the lab

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Stoltz leads the FBI raid in the woods and arrests Hank and Hope when they shrink their lab. He then slips away with the lab to hand it to Burch.
stages.whoA: The scientist he arrests and robs
stages.whoB: Stoltz, the agent who arrests him

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Burch learns about Hope's fake identity through Stoltz. Stoltz later surrounds her with FBI agents, arrests her and Hank, and takes their lab.
stages.whoA: The woman he arrests for Burch
stages.whoB: Stoltz, Burch's mole in the FBI

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Rumlow orders Klein to launch the helicarriers, and Klein refuses, saying Captain's orders. Rumlow pulls a gun on him, and the standoff turns into a gunfight.
stages.whoA: The HYDRA agent who pulls a gun on him
stages.whoB: Klein, the technician who will not launch

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: When Rumlow threatens Klein for refusing to launch, Sharon draws on Rumlow and repeats Captain's orders. She keeps Klein alive as the shooting starts.
stages.whoA: The agent who saves his life
stages.whoB: Klein, the technician she protects

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Fury brings an old helicarrier out of mothballs with a few old friends, Klein among them. Klein runs the lifeboat launch and reports to Fury as Sokovians fill the boats.
stages.whoA: The director who brings him back
stages.whoB: Klein, who launches his lifeboats

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Klein and Hill work the helicarrier bridge over Sokovia, launching lifeboats and taking on refugees. When Ultron's drones attack the bridge, Hill and Fury fight them off.
stages.whoA: His fellow agent on Fury's bridge
stages.whoB: Klein, the lifeboat technician

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: In a vision Wanda forces on her, Natasha relives her Red Room training under Madame B., who drives her to break and tells her the graduation ceremony will give her a place in the world. Natasha later tells Bruce the ceremony sterilized her.
stages.whoA: The girl she trains to kill
stages.whoB: Madame B., her Red Room trainer

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Limbani poses as a medic with Klaue to rob a London museum of a vibranium axe. He helps break Klaue out of CIA custody, and at the airfield Killmonger shoots him when Klaue refuses to take him to Wakanda.
stages.whoA: The boss he robs and shoots for
stages.whoB: Limbani, one of his gunmen

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Limbani works with Killmonger on the museum robbery and Klaue's escape. When Klaue refuses to take Killmonger to Wakanda, Killmonger shoots Limbani dead.
stages.whoA: The partner who kills him
stages.whoB: Limbani, Klaue's gunman he shoots

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Limbani and Linda rob the London museum with Klaue and Killmonger, then help free Klaue from the CIA. Both die at the airfield.
stages.whoA: Killmonger's partner on the job
stages.whoB: Limbani, a gunman on the same job

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Sope gives Killmonger the Heart-Shaped Herb and helps him breathe when he wakes. When she refuses to burn the garden, he chokes her until she obeys.
stages.whoA: The new king who makes her burn the herbs
stages.whoB: The shaman he forces to burn the herbs

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Sope and Zawavari lead Wakanda's rites, from T'Challa's funeral to the coronation they prepare for Shuri. Shuri never comes, and M'Baku claims the challenge.
stages.whoA: The elder who presents the new ruler
stages.whoB: Sope, the shaman at her side

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Zawavari laughs when Killmonger asks the council for the throne, then falls silent when he names himself N'Jadaka. After he beats T'Challa, she must bow to him and hear his plan to arm the world.
stages.whoA: The outsider she laughs at, then must obey
stages.whoB: Zawavari, the elder who laughs at him

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Zawavari's Mining Tribe declines to challenge at T'Challa's coronation, and she sits on his council. She watches in horror as Killmonger throws him from the falls.
stages.whoA: The king she serves on the council
stages.whoB: Zawavari, the Mining Tribe elder

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Zawavari and Ramonda sit together on the council when Killmonger demands the throne. Ramonda calls him a charlatan, and both watch him take Wakanda.
stages.whoA: The queen mother on the council
stages.whoB: Zawavari, a council elder

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Zawavari stands at T'Challa's funeral as Ramonda becomes queen. She serves on Ramonda's council as Namor's threat grows.
stages.whoA: The queen she serves
stages.whoB: Zawavari, an elder on her council

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: With the elders sheltering with M'Baku, Zawavari presses them to choose a ruler. At the coronation she presents Shuri, but M'Baku steps up instead to challenge for the throne.
stages.whoA: The Jabari leader who claims the challenge
stages.whoB: Zawavari, the elder at the coronation

dropped.why: No real part in the plot: his only confirmed line is one doorman's question to Doom in Fantastic Four (2005) ('Mr Von Doom, are you okay?'), which changes nothing, and no line in Rise of the Silver Surfer can be pinned to him.

changes.why: Only one confirmed line (a doorman asking Doom if he is okay) and no part in the plot; the Silver Surfer usher line is not his by any source. FILMNAME.md still requires lines and a part in the plot.

changes.why: Ghost takes the lab when she kills him; the agents find his body and the lab gone, not beside it.

Credited name confirmed in Wakanda Forever (MCU wiki credits and Wikipedia cast); Black Panther credits only 'Mining Tribe Elder'.
